researchMethod: Direct, unlimited-depth manual traversal of the real, already-paid-for compiled output from the immediately preceding session's holdout re-run (tests/fixtures/unseen-packages/post-holdout-semantic-remediation-rerun/) - specifically the full nested attemptedStructure trees for A2 (net-income), A5 (secured-net-leverage), and B2 (Applicable Rate, inside the applicable-liquidity-rate region) - to determine the TRUE underlying failure mechanism per Section 13's own 7-way taxonomy, without any new paid model call. No new production code was read or modified before this analysis was complete.
keyFindingSummary: The full-depth manual traversal (which the production checkIntraDefinitionComponentCompleteness diagnostic does NOT itself perform - see 01/03) revealed that: (1) the model handles very high cardinality (19 individually-reasoned leaf clauses in one A2 sub-tree) with full fidelity in a single pass, refuting the mission's own working cognitive-overload hypothesis for that case; (2) the model's own real UNSUPPORTED leaf reasons are precise, evidence-based, and narrow (a discretionary lender-election right, an underdetermined source drafting gap, a context-dependent branching condition) - not generic catch-alls or dropped material; (3) B2's Applicable Rate is compiled as an 8-level-deep chain of nested IF nodes (a de facto hand-rolled pricing-grid encoding) where TWO narrow, deep, genuinely-unsupported leaves poison the ENTIRE ancestor chain's top-level executability verdict via ordinary, correct, unmodified poison propagation - and the CURRENT completeness diagnostic (checkIntraDefinitionComponentCompleteness, added in the immediately preceding session) does NOT descend into a nested UNSUPPORTED node's own attemptedStructure, so it UNDERCOUNTS how much of a deeply-nested tree actually survived (reports 2/4 components for B2 when the true count, confirmed by manual unlimited-depth traversal, is roughly 36/38). This is the real, concrete, bounded architectural finding this session's implementation targets - see 01/03.
scopeStatement: Per the mission's own Section 0/32 gate, commit 1 (artifacts 00-03) is architecture analysis only - zero production code changes.
